title: Mo Xiansheng's Gift
next_chapter_hook: The prophetic vision from the jade slip still flickered before his eyes—Chapter 700's deadly trap. Who was secretly manipulating the board? And was that variable, unseen even by the Tianji Record, already lurking by his side?

text.content: Night wind swept through the decrepit dwelling where Chen Ji sat alone, the recent upheaval still vivid in his mind. He meditated with closed eyes, observing how the cracks on the Tianji Record's fragmented pages seemed to deepen—a consequence of overusing heavenly foresight. Suddenly, an ancient yet familiar voice resonated in his consciousness, belonging to Mo Xiansheng, the fragmented soul dwelling on the record's first page. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, surroundings unchanged, but the voice was crystal clear as if spoken beside him: 'Come, young one, follow me.'

Chen Ji followed the pull of consciousness, his soul sinking into the depths of his Mental Sea. The Tianji Record floated in the Void, its ancient pages rustling without wind, the ink on its first page faintly glowing with a dark luminescence. After a moment, a phantom figure slowly materialized from the pages. It was a white-haired elder, his face withered yet his gaze piercing, surrounded by wisps of dark ink-like mist. His fragmented soul flickered uncertainly, yet radiated a terrifying pressure. 'You've come.' Mo Xiansheng's voice was hoarse and weary. 'There are some things you must now know.'

dialogue.content: 'Do you know how your father Chen Xuan died?' Mo Xiansheng stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, that gaze seeming to penetrate all illusions. 'You think he died surrounded by the three major sects? No... he died by his own prophecy. Died in that chess game he knew would be fatal, yet chose to walk into anyway.'

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He had always believed his father died from sect conflicts, from the combined schemes of greedy men, never imagining the truth could be so—he died by his own prophecy? Mo Xiansheng let out a bitter sigh, mixed with a century of vicissitudes: 'Because I was his teacher, I know better than anyone... Chen Xuan never had true freedom. Every choice he made was on heaven's chessboard.'

dialogue.content: 'You think the Tianji Record chose you as its heir simply because of your exceptional talent?' Mo Xiansheng's withered finger pointed at Chen Ji's chest. 'Wrong. The Tianji Record chose you because there is something on you that Chen Xuan lacked—a variable even heaven's all-seeing eye cannot perceive. This variable is your only chance of survival, and it was also the final theme of your father's last prophecy before his death.'

text.content: Mo Xiansheng turned, and suddenly a jade slip of pure luster materialized in the void. The slip radiated a faint silver glow, its surface bearing faint chess-game patterns—clearly something of immense value sealed within. 'This is what I've guarded for twenty years.' Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled slightly. 'Before his death, Chen Xuan sealed his final chess game prophecy within. He asked me to give it to you when you possessed the strength to bear the truth.'

dialogue.content: 'The strength to bear the truth?' Chen Ji took the jade slip, its warmth reminiscent of his father's lingering presence. Mo Xiansheng nodded, his gaze profound: 'The prophecy sealed within will show you the true cause of your death in Chapter 700. But each vision requires consuming ten years of your lifespan as payment—this was Chen Xuan's restriction, and his way of protecting you. He didn't want you to enter this road of no return too early.'

choice.prompt: The prophecy within the jade slip concerned the truth of Chen Ji's death in Chapter 700—this was both the key to breaking fate's chains and possibly an accelerating poison. Facing this difficult choice, Chen Ji had to decide:

choices.text: Face destiny and view the prophecy immediately
choices.description: Since the deadly trap is already set, better to see the board clearly. The cost of ten years of lifespan might exchange for crucial information to change destiny.
choices.visible_reward: Glimpse the key clues to the cause of death in Chapter 700
choices.risk_hint: The cost of ten years of lifespan is extremely heavy, and the prophecy results may bring greater psychological shock

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, pressing the jade slip against his brow center. In an instant, a torrential flow of information flooded into his Mental Sea like a flood—he saw it—the vast chessboard above, countless points of light intersecting, and among them, one dim point was himself. The moment that point finally extinguished was precisely at Chapter 700...

dialogue.content: 'Did you see it clearly?' Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded by his ear. 'The core variable that causes your death doesn't come from the outside... it comes from the person closest to you.'

choices.text: Delay investigation and consolidate foundation first
choices.description: Ten years of lifespan is too heavy a cost, and acting rashly with an unstable foundation is unwise. Better to first improve your strength and make decisions when the time is right.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve lifespan and gain more capital for later schemes
choices.risk_hint: Delaying understanding of the truth may lead to passivity, but can better conceal intentions

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the jade slip into his chest, looking up at Mo Xiansheng: 'Ten years of lifespan is no small account. This disciple wishes to live a few more years, to see the full picture of this world's chess game.' Upon hearing this, a hint of approval actually flickered in Mo Xiansheng's eyes: 'Good. Patience. You are indeed Chen Xuan's son.'

Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly asked: 'Master just said the Tianji Record chose me because of a variable my father lacked. What exactly is this variable?' Mo Xiansheng shook his head, his fragmented soul slightly dimming: 'This matter involves the core mysteries of the Tianji Record; I cannot tell you prematurely. But I can tell you one thing—that variable is related to your missing sister Chen Nian.'

Hearing Chen Nian's name, Chen Ji's heart shook violently. That sister taken by the Holy Sect as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' he had never stopped searching for. Mo Xiansheng continued: 'Chen Nian's existence interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight—any prophetic vision containing her is blurred. This is both her curse and her gift. Searching for her isn't just about sibling affection; it's about your own path to survival.'

dialogue.content: 'Master, this disciple has another question.' Chen Ji's gaze burned intently. 'Since Father had already prophesied my deadly trap, why did he still pass the Tianji Record to me? Did he not know this would only make me die faster?' Mo Xiansheng turned to gaze at the void, his voice ethereal: 'Because he believed you could break that deadly trap. Chen Xuan's last words before his death were—'My son shall venture further than I ever could.'

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng is about to reveal an important piece of information that may change the entire situation:

choices.text: Press for details of father's final prophecy
choices.description: Since we've come this far, might as well dig to the bottom of father's legacy. That prophecy may hold more unsolved mysteries.
choices.visible_cost: Consume energy and possibly touch Mo Xiansheng's taboos
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about father's schemes
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may be holding back; pressing too deep may anger the other party

text.content: Chen Ji pressed further: 'In that final prophecy, besides seeing my deadly trap, did Father see a way to break it?' Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long while before finally speaking: 'He saw it. But that method requires you to gather all the fragments of the Tianji Record... and before that, you need to first survive Chapter 700.'

choices.text: Solemnly thank the Ancestral Master's teachings
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng was father's teacher; by extension, he is this disciple's ancestral master. One day as a teacher, a lifetime as a father—this kindness cannot be forgotten.
choices.visible_reward: Draw closer to Mo Xiansheng and may receive additional guidance
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as weak, but actual benefits are often unexpected

dialogue.content: Chen Ji bowed respectfully: 'Disciple Chen Ji thanks the Ancestral Master for twenty years of guarding and kindness.' Mo Xiansheng's withered palm lightly pressed on Chen Ji's head, the touch ethereal yet warm: 'Good child. If your father has knowledge of this from the underworld, he should smile contentedly.' With these words, he suddenly produced an ancient token from his sleeve. 'This is the key to enter the Ancient Forbidden Land. In three days, when the realm opens, present this token to enter and cultivate within. There, perhaps you will find clues about Chen Nian.'

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's figure gradually faded; before disappearing entirely, he cast one final look at Chen Ji, speaking with earnest sincerity: 'Remember, a true chess player is never within the chessboard. Your father lost because he always tried to resist heaven alone. But you... should learn to borrow momentum. Borrow the momentum of all under heaven to break heaven's game.' The words fell, the Tianji Record's pages slowly closed, and Mo Xiansheng's figure completely vanished into the void.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes; outside, the sky had already begun to brighten. He looked down at the jade slip and token in his chest, his heart filled with mixed emotions. Father's final prophecy, Chapter 700's deadly trap, missing sister Chen Nian... all these clues intertwined, vaguely pointing to a chilling truth—the person closest to him was the true cause of his death. And where exactly was that variable, unseen even by the Tianji Record, lurking now?

'The closest person...' Chen Ji murmured to himself, images of Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and even the seemingly kind old Sect Master Ling Yuan flashing through his mind. Mo Xiansheng said searching for Chen Nian was the key to breaking the trap—then was the Holy Sect's taking of Chen Nian also for the same purpose? The realm opening in three days might be the starting point for unraveling all these mysteries.
